entities.text: HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  AT JABALPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.245/2023 registered at Police Station - Kotwali Shahdol, District - Shahdol (M.P.) for commission of offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 323, 506 & 377 of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 17.03.2023.
As per prosecution case, the allegation against the present applicant is that he committed sexual intercourse with the prosecutrix at several time without her consent.

Accordingly, a case has been Mohammad Sajid Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109734600/
1 registered against the present applicant.

entities.text: Mohammad Sajid Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the alleged offence.

It is further submitted that from a bare perusal of the FIR and the charge-sheet makes it clear that the prosecutrix was complacent with alleged sexual assault, because applicant promised to get her share in ancestral property from her brother.
It is also submitted that,
prosecutrix
is aged about 37 years and is a major lady
. No external as well as internal injuries were found on the person of prosecutrix.
It is also submitted that, the alleged crime is continued since the last three years, but the prosecutrix has never report the incident to any police authorities prior to lodging of the FIR.
The instant crime has been registered by seeking advice and subsequently gave a written complaint to the Police Officer.
The applicant is in custody since 17.03.2023.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Under such circumstances, he prays for grant of bail.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer and prays for its rejection.
Learned counsel appearing for objector also opposed the bail application and prays for its rejection.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, on a perusal of the materials available on record including the case diary, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
The M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed off.
Pending I.As, if any, shall also stands disposed off.
Certified Copy as per rules.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR (VERMA)) JUDGE Amitabh Mohammad Sajid Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109734600/
